package task

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
)

func normalizeTranslations(entries []domain.TaskI18n) []domain.TaskI18n {
	seen := make(map[int]struct{})
	result := make([]domain.TaskI18n, 0, len(entries))
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if entry.I18nID <= 0 {
			continue
		}
		title := strings.TrimSpace(entry.Title)
		description := strings.TrimSpace(entry.Description)
		if title == "" || description == "" {
			continue
		}
		if _, ok := seen[entry.I18nID]; ok {
			continue
		}
		seen[entry.I18nID] = struct{}{}
		entry.Title = title
		entry.Description = description
		result = append(result, entry)
	}
	return result
}

func normalizeTaskStarterFiles(taskID string, items []domain.TaskFileStorage) []domain.TaskFileStorage {
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(items))
	result := make([]domain.TaskFileStorage, 0, len(items))
	for _, item := range items {
		fileID := strings.TrimSpace(item.FileStorageID)
		if fileID == "" {
			continue
		}
		key := fmt.Sprintf("%d:%d:%s", item.Type, item.Order, fileID)
		if _, ok := seen[key]; ok {
			continue
		}
		seen[key] = struct{}{}
		result = append(result, domain.TaskFileStorage{
			TaskID:        taskID,
			Type:          item.Type,
			FileStorageID: fileID,
			Order:         item.Order,
		})
	}
	return result
}
